Robinhood may decline enrollment or change/terminate the terms at its discretion.

steps: Confirm you directly received this tiered deposit promotion from Robinhood — without the targeted offer you cannot enroll.
Open the new Robinhood account through the promotion link or offer you received.
Get approved, then initiate and settle a deposit of $10,000-$24,999.99 within the 7-day period following account approval to hit the $200 tier.
Do not withdraw below $10,000 for one year — the qualifying deposit and the reward are locked, and dropping below can trigger rescission.
The $200 reward normally credits around day eight after approval (allow about one more week).
The reward cash itself cannot be withdrawn for one year; keep the account open and in good standing.
